results.explanation: source_supported_failure: At the declared POST /process/file entry, the non-admin path binds the supplied file to the authenticated user, while the supplied collection_name is carried into the vector-database save call. The source-visible path does not invoke the separately declared collection-access validator or show any destination ownership/write-grant check before the write sink. For an existing collection, add=True is supplied and the save helper inserts items into the named collection. Thus the source supports that a verified non-admin file owner can cause the file content to be written to the caller-selected existing collection without a destination write grant. File ownership is enforced only for retrieval of the source file; it is distinct from permission to write the destination knowledge-base collection. This is bounded to the supplied declared entry and source crop, not a repository-wide or deployment claim.
